channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Trump says Iran war will end 'when I want it to' as costs reportedly balloon to $47 billion
item.description: Trump's statement comes as a report from The Hill revealed that the costs of the Iran conflict has ballooned to $47 billion.

item.title: UBS pre-tax profits jump 27% to $3.59 billion in the third quarter
Oil prices rise as Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabian refinery raise supply worries
item.description: Oil prices climbed Wednesday as investors weighed the prospect of a prolonged conflict in the Middle East.

item.title: Stock futures are mixed as traders await Fed decision, Big Tech earnings: Live updates
item.description: The moves came after stocks were broadly higher on Tuesday, fueled by gains among semiconductor companies.

item.title: Israel election appears to have no clear winner with Netanyahu, opponent Eisenkot far short of majorities
item.description: Exit polls show Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's alliance and Gadi Eisenkot's opposition bloc both well off the numbers needed to form a governing majority.

item.title: Meta- and Google-backed Jio Platforms’ shares soar over 21% on trading debut after record IPO
item.description: Jio had offered 270 million shares in the IPO priced at 1,119 rupees apiece, raising 302 billion rupees ($3.2 billion) in the country's largest-ever IPO.

item.title: Early third-quarter earnings show a 'resilient' U.S. consumer, with signs of strain
item.description: Companies from Royal Caribbean to Coca-Cola and UPS say they are seeing steady consumer spending despite high inflation.

item.title: SK Hynix shares soar over 10 % as profit beats, chipmaker to return $25 billion to investors
item.description: Shares of South Korean chipmaker SK Hynix soared over 10% on Wednesday as third-quarter profit sharply beats estimates.

item.title: Trump jokes $5,000 would buy 'a hamburger and maybe a small dessert' at Mar-a-Lago as cost of living looms over midterms
item.description: Trump joked that the $5,000 payments for U.S. adults would buy little more than "a hamburger and maybe a small dessert" as cost of living looms over midterms.

item.title: CNBC 2026 Workforce Executive Summit takeaways: How AI is transforming jobs, hiring, and employee benefits
item.description: Follow CNBC's 2026 Workforce Executive Summit for live updates on Walmart's AI strategy, changing job skills, hiring, employee benefits and the future of work.

item.title: Anthropic's IPO could be 'speculative fiction' or a 'generational moment' — investors are split
item.description: Investors are digesting Anthropic's S-1 filing that the Securities and Exchange Commission released on Monday.

item.title: Kylian Mbappé faces China backlash as sponsors cut ties over viral meme
item.description: Chinese state media has warned Kylian Mbappé that his apology over remarks referring to Mao Zedong as a dictator will be judged against his actions.

item.title: Indian investors rush to Nvidia, SpaceX, Apple as local trading apps roll out access to U.S. stocks
item.description: Major Indian brokerages are providing retail investors access to U.S. stocks at a time when the local market has been battered.

item.title: How investors can position ahead of the Fed's next policy decision
item.description: The Federal Reserve's October rate decision has been a focus for investors and economists as Chairman Kevin Warsh has rejected traditional forward guidance.

item.title: Speaker Mike Johnson calls election-transfer concerns ‘absurd’
item.description: Democrats and voting rights groups have raised concerns that President Donald Trump and congressional Republicans could challenge election results if they lose.

item.title: Amazon's anti-tokenmaxxing memo says engineers should be pickier about using AI
item.description: Amazon has rapidly integrated AI across the e-commerce giant's sprawling business operations under CEO Andy Jassy.

item.title: I just bought this pharma stock for its next generation of blockbuster drugs — and its dividend
item.description: AbbVie is entering a new chapter of growth, fueled by its blockbuster immunology drugs and expanding neuroscience business. Investor Kevin Simpson shares why he's optimistic.

item.title: Labubu-maker Pop Mart's shares extend declines as third-quarter sales plunge
item.description: The company reported a 45% to 50% year-on-year drop in third-quarter revenue.

item.title: Trump administration may let more Russian diesel onto market, energy secretary tells CNBC
item.description: The diesel volumes in the Trump-Putin deal won't materially lower prices because the shipments are small compared to total demand, analysts say.

item.title: China and Russia are redrawing Arctic trade. Can Europe fight back?
item.description: China and Russia are tightening their grip on Arctic shipping routes, turning the rapidly warming region into a new geopolitical battleground with Europe.

item.title: Boeing shares slide on a disappointing cash flow update. Why this dip is buyable
item.description: Boeing reset investor expectations on free cash flow growth in the coming years. We're hopeful this represents a clearing event.

item.title: Amex Platinum and Business Platinum add Airbnb perks, but lodging credit rules are tightening
item.description: American Express adds Airbnb bookings and new benefits for Platinum and Business Platinum cardmembers, alongside tightening rules for a popular lodging credit.

item.title: Grand jury rejects DOJ bid to indict ex-Trump WH aide Cassidy Hutchinson: Reports
item.description: Prosecutors aimed to charge Cassidy Hutchinson over testimony about President Trump's conduct the day of the Jan. 6, 2021, U.S. Capitol riot by his supporters.

item.title: Chart: Anthropic's cash pile towers over nearly every U.S. company

item.title: From Wall Street to Silicon Valley, Anthropic IPO poised to have massive 'trickle-down effect'

item.title: Neil Young sues Trump committee for $10M for playing 'Rockin' in the Free World' at rally
item.description: "'Rockin' in the Free World' is the opposite of everything that Donald J. Trump stands for," the suit by the two-time Rock and Roll Hall of Fame member says.

item.title: Polymarket faces renewed CFTC probe over U.S. access to offshore platform
item.description: The federal agency had previously investigated whether Polymarket allowed U.S. users on to its offshore platform in 2024, but dropped the measures in July 2025.
